title: src/glovebox
subtitle: The gate: bearer token, three read tools (list, count, group), fixture mail source, SQLite store and the output validator

evidence.note: Only the acceptance tests' MCP client connects today; inferred as the agent.
Outermost middleware; compares the bearer token before anything else runs and records the caller's identity that page cursors are bound to.
Low-level Server with only tools/list and tools/call handlers: no resources or prompts.

Validates the call's inputs, checks the cursor, then answers from the store; a failed sync is recorded as stale or blocked and answered with the fixed outage error; the sort orders, filters and the 1000+ cap live in store.py.
Reads GLOVEBOX_HOST and GLOVEBOX_PORT, builds the app from the environment.
The only code that sees raw upstream structure; reads no text field. Tells a blocked source from a down one and counts items it could not parse.

Permitted fields, keyed-digest handle mappings and sync state (status, last successful sync, skipped count, and which account a source last served); no raw text. Mail outside the 30-day window is not stored.
Checks the whole result; a failure becomes the fixed response_invalid error.
add_middleware makes the token check the outermost layer of the app.
